Thank You, Jacksonville.

The Mission Behind the PAWty

Every Dollar Moves the Needle

Eye Spy Foundation

Funds raised support the blind and low vision community through resources, technology, education, and connection — so no one faces vision loss alone.

Learn about Eye Spy Foundation

Leader Dogs for the Blind

A portion of every dollar helps train future guide dogs — giving people who are blind or have low vision the freedom and confidence to navigate the world.

Learn about Leader Dogs for the Blind
